title_short: End of Year · 20 Years of Opportunity
eyebrow: Soles4Souls · End of Year 2026 · 20th anniversary · Nashville staff retreat footage, 14 Oct
title: End of Year:
headline: For 20 years Soles4Souls has been creating opportunity, and this December you can keep it going: staff faces first, then Teresa and kids in new shoes.
story: Staff faces carry the first half: quick, silent smiles between their answers, under Sydney's first two cards. Then Teresa Miller, VP of Development, says what one gift means, and kids with new shoes carry the second half. Teresa closes on “so much good in the world”.

Loops: L1 “Opportunity for who?” opens at 0:00 and closes at about 0:12 when the kids appear under Teresa's “opportunity for a student”. L2 “What can I do?” closes on the end slide. Stakes: 5,000 kids need new shoes by 31 December.
This is not a thank-you montage: that video already exists from this shoot. No staff “thank you” lines.
do: Card 1 on screen at frame 1. It does not animate on.
Staff faces between their answers, sound off, about 1 s each.
Teresa's two lines word for word, with captions (black text on the teal box).
Name super at 00:09, lower left, 2 s: Teresa Miller / VP of Development.
Clean Teresa's audio first: noise print, noise reduction, level pass.
dont: No staff “thank you” line and no line already in the other Nashville cuts (marked in the transcript).
No logo before the end slide, and none on it: the wordmark is already on the slide.
No Christmas imagery. Holiday vibes only.
